intent.initial: An agent-written chip spawned by 207f7bdf at 05:11:37Z: 'Stop deny rows refusing work in scratch fixture repos'. A replay of 175 logged refusals found more than 100 were real commands in throwaway fixture repos: marker writes, git remote add, update-ref refs/remotes and git add -A. The chip asks for a design and build that lets a row apply only to the governed checkout. The new column must default to today's behaviour, invariant 2 must hold, and the engine must name no project. intent.final: As built: deny.tsv gets an optional fourth column, `scope`. The reader is lib/where-read.sh (awk in a shell string) and the judge is lib/where.sh. The reader stops at 32 KB. Each lift is logged to says.log as `lifted`.
